name: mmsave-tiles-blobs-sd
description: the editor re-renders war3mapMap.blp on every save (the input's is flat.w3x's picture, a different map; the editor's save of this map is the picture of its ground, which Studio's rebuild matches): the ground in squares of 4 x 4 corners (tiles with two to four textures at the squares' edges), 16-pixel squares within 8 per channel (the largest was 3; both draw a tile by its south-west corner and differ in the edge pixels, see TESTING.md 'Export Minimap and the saved minimap'). SD. Not the random-corner map (minimap-tiles-rand.w3x): there the editor's JPEG itself moves the colours (its saved picture is redder than its own export by 6 to 9 on the green textures, blue 8 lower on Lrok: its encoder's chroma), squares differ by up to 15

name: mmsave-tiles-blobs-hd
description: the same in HD (the ground colours are the _Diffuse textures')

name: mmsave-dots-sd
description: 48 isolated doodads of three kinds (a rock 4x4, an elven house 6x6, a goblin shipyard ruin 8x8 pathing), SD: the dots' colours (the ruin: the mean of its textures, team colour black) and places agree within 12 per channel in 16-pixel squares. Not the dots' shape: the editor draws sharp squares of 2 tiles whatever the texture (8 x 8 pixels here, the corner pixels out), Studio softened discs of 1, 1.4 and 2.8 tiles; the largest square difference is the shape's (8 now, 19 before the colour change)

name: mmsave-dots-hd
description: the same in HD: before branch we-minimap-checks Studio drew no dot at all (an HD model's .tif texture isn't in the game, only its .dds; the largest square difference 21), the editor's are there (its colours: the _Diffuse textures'; now 10)
